From brief to running ads in five steps

For UGC ads you send a product and a few lines about your customer. For brand ads you just send your website link. We handle everything between that and finished ads.

STEP 01

You send the product — or just your link

Real-creator ads: ship us the product and your brief. AI ads and brand ads: just send your website — we pull your branding from it.

STEP 02

We write the hook + script

Problem → product → result, in the creator’s own voice. The first line is written to stop the scroll in 2 seconds.

STEP 03

Creator films — or AI generates

A matched creator films on their phone, an AI avatar performs the script — or AI builds your branded static and video ads from your branding.

STEP 04

We edit it into an ad

Fast cuts, captions, product close-ups and a clear call to action — cut for the feed, not for TV.

STEP 05

You get variations to run

Finished ads ready to upload to Instagram, Facebook or TikTok Ads — 9:16 video, plus 4:5 and 1:1 statics for brand ads. Different hooks and looks, so you can test what converts — then scale the winner.

Why brands are moving budget from big productions to ads like these

Real > polished

People trust people

A polished commercial gets scrolled past like every other ad. A real person, in their own room, saying “this actually worked for me” gets watched — and believed.

0–2s

The hook decides everything

Feeds are won or lost in the first two seconds. Every script we write opens with the problem, a pattern-break or a bold claim — never a logo, never “introducing…”

5–7 days

Fast enough to test weekly

No studio bookings, no month-long productions. Brief to finished ads in 5–7 days, so you can test new hooks every week and scale the ones that sell.

The playbook: AI finds the winner, real creators scale it

Run a batch of AI variations — UGC hooks or branded ads — and find what converts. The winner gets scaled: more variations of it, or a remake with a real creator for higher trust. Cheap testing, premium scaling.

AI variations batch→ Find the winning hook→ Remake with real creators→ Scale the winner
